screens_reviewed: Single screenshot of the Dashboard (tabs index) at the top scroll position, Android tablet, light theme.
verdict: The Dashboard renders cleanly and is usable, but it is essentially a phone layout centered on the tablet canvas rather than a large-screen adaptation: a single content column, two-up metric cards, and a bottom tab bar instead of a Material nav rail. Typography is also notably small for a tablet because the ScaledText/ScaledParagraph primitives never apply the TABLET_TYPOGRAPHY_BASE_SCALE the design system defines. Nothing is broken, but the screen leaves obvious tablet affordances on the table.

improvements.suggestion: Apply the defined TABLET_TYPOGRAPHY_BASE_SCALE (1.3) on tablet widths. ScaledText/ScaledParagraph multiply fontSize/lineHeight only by the user fontScale preference; they have no awareness of the tablet tier, so explicit sizes like fontSize={10} eyebrows, fontSize={13} status text, and fontSize={34} heading render at phone px on the large canvas. Fold the tablet base scale into scaleSize (e.g. read useResponsiveLayout()/isTablet or compose it into the active fontScale).
improvements.evidence: core.md:2285-2321 (scaleSize multiplies by fontScale only); core.md:792 defines TABLET_TYPOGRAPHY_BASE_SCALE=1.3 with a comment that it should make tablet text legible without raising the slider; image shows small eyebrow/body text relative to canvas

improvements.location: app/(tabs)/index.tsx:300-309 (XStack flexWrap) and MetricCard width at lines 605-617
improvements.suggestion: MetricCard hard-codes width="48%" with minWidth:160, forcing a 2x2 grid even though the centered tablet content track is ~1040-1200px wide and could show all four metrics in one row. Switch to a responsive column count (e.g. ~24% / minWidth on tablet, or a $columns media style) so the four metrics use the available width instead of leaving a tall stacked block.
improvements.evidence: app/(tabs)/index.tsx:606 width="48%"; lib/responsive-layout-tokens.ts contentMaxWidth 1040-1200 (core.md:779-780); image shows 2x2 metric layout with spare horizontal room

improvements.location: app/(tabs)/index.tsx:110-119 (ScrollView contentContainer) and overall YStack structure
improvements.suggestion: The route uses getResponsiveContentContainerStyle to center one column but never builds a multi-column / master-detail layout. The design system already defines homePageSupportRailWidth (250-290 on tablet) which this screen does not consume. Consider a two-pane tablet layout (e.g. summary/metrics column + assigned-places column, or a support rail) so the wide canvas is used rather than centering a phone column.
improvements.evidence: lib/responsive-layout-tokens.ts homePageSupportRailWidth 250/290 (core.md:818,836) is defined but app/(tabs)/index.tsx never references homePageSupportRailWidth or layout.isTablet branching; image shows centered single column

improvements.suggestion: Material large-screen guidance favors a navigation rail (side) over a bottom navigation bar on tablets. The layout uses expo-router Tabs with a bottom tabBar for all sizes; it adds tablet tweaks (icon size 22, item radius/margins) but stays bottom-anchored. Consider a nav rail on tablet widths for a more native Android-tablet feel.
improvements.evidence: app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx tabBarStyle is a bottom bar with isTablet only adjusting padding/margins/icon size (core.md:1444-1491); image shows bottom tab bar HOME/PLACES/EXECUTE/REPORTS

tamagui_notes: Dashboard correctly routes all text through ScaledText/ScaledParagraph (the pack's design_system_components_used), so the user font-scale preference is honored; the gap is that these primitives never layer in the tablet base scale (core.md:2285-2321 vs core.md:792).

MetricCard mixes Tamagui token props with raw style: width="48%" plus inline style minWidth/boxShadow/borderColor/backgroundColor (app/(tabs)/index.tsx:605-617). The fixed 48% is the cause of the non-responsive grid; consider tablet-aware sizing instead of a literal percentage.

The hero card uses a hard-coded borderColor 'rgba(71, 203, 175, 0.18)' and rgba white text colors (app/(tabs)/index.tsx:314, 322, 339) rather than design-system tokens; not a tablet issue but an inline-color consistency note.
platform_notes: Status bar / nav-bar: app uses useHiddenAndroidNavBar (core.md:1069) to hide the Android nav bar and the ScrollView uses contentInsetAdjustmentBehavior; the top content clears the status bar in the image. No safe-area clipping visible.

Tap targets: header icon Buttons are 42x42 (app/(tabs)/index.tsx:157-189) and avatar tile 44x44; 42dp is just under the Android 48dp minimum touch target. Primary CTAs (View places / Open audit / View reports, per-place Start/Continue) are comfortably sized.
Bottom tab bar uses the standard Material-ish bottom nav rather than a tablet nav rail (see improvements).
not_assessable: Exact rendered font sizes / whether the tablet base scale is intentionally omitted at runtime (only the primitive source is visible).
Scroll content below the first 'Assigned places' card (only one scroll position provided).
Precise contrast ratios; no pair looked clearly below WCAG AA in the light theme.
Landscape / split-view behavior on the tablet (only one portrait capture).
score_rationale: Usable with clear problems: the screen is polished and functional but is a centered phone layout on a tablet (two-up metrics, single column, bottom tabs) and does not apply its own defined TABLET_TYPOGRAPHY_BASE_SCALE, so it under-uses the large canvas. No critical/broken issues, which keeps it above the 3-4 band, but the missed tablet adaptations hold it out of 7-8.
